messages:
Aisha: Quick ops — final loop for Candidate M is set for Thu 11:00am PT. We need panel coverage + a debrief scribe. Please confirm availability or swaps here. Candidate is IC backend; take-home PR linked below — it'd be great if interviewers can skim beforehand.

Aisha: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/candidates/pull/312  — please add a short comment if you see anything we should call out during the loop.

calendar-bot: Event created: Candidate M — Final Loop — Thu 11:00am PT — 60m — Zoom (link in calendar). Organizer: Aisha.

Jordan: I can cover system design + product Qs. Noted on PR — will skim tonight.

Mei: I can do system design as well, can alternate with Jordan depending on flow. I'll review the PR today and flag anything.

Tomas: Happy to scribe and handle coding exercise + code review Qs. Can someone share the debrief doc link? Also — any rubric clarifications (weights)?

Aisha: Debrief doc: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/interviews/debrief-template (please copy into candidate folder). Scribe should capture 3 quick takeaways and 2 potential risks. Quick rubric anchors below — use as a guide, not a checklist: 

```
System design / architecture: 40%
Coding correctness & style: 30%
Communication & collaboration (behavioral): 20%
Product sense & tradeoffs: 10%
```

Aisha: If infra experience is relevant, call it out under "System design" with a short note.

Priya: Small clarification — candidate's PR seems infra-heavy. Can infra be a separate checkbox so we don't lose granularity?

Jordan: +1. I usually fold infra into system design but add a separate infra note when it's signal. That should work for calibration later.

Mei: Heads up — I saw a flaky test in the PR (integration test on setup). I'll leave a comment on the PR and tag @tomas for follow-up.

Tomas: Thanks — I'll add a short comment and mark the failing test as "investigate". I'll also add a quick "ready for panel" label when done.

Aisha: Great — if you end up swapping coverage, ping here so I update the calendar and scribe assignment. Also please arrive ~5min early and use the debrief template during the 10min post-interview window. I'll post a debrief reminder in the channel ~10m after the loop.

calendar-bot: Reminder scheduled: Debrief prompt — Thu 12:10pm PT (10m after interview).

Jordan: Got it, thanks :thumbsup:

Mei: Noted :eyes:

Priya: If someone needs to swap, I can cover late afternoon — ping me and I'll confirm.

Tomas: All set on my end. Will do scribe and leave the PR note by EOD.

Aisha: Thank you all — I'll follow up with the recording consent blurb (candidate asked for recording) and the final attendee list tomorrow morning.

Jordan: Recording consent — please confirm with candidate and put consent note in the calendar event.

Aisha: Will do.
